messages:
maria (People Ops): Heads-up: building a small 'skip-level calibration pack' managers can paste into skip-level notes and calibration sheets. Need 2 quick templates: manager note + one-line IC summary. Want quick review.

devin (Eng Manager): Nice. Keeping it short is key. Can you include a section for headcount asks?

maria (People Ops): Draft below — feedback welcome.

```
MANAGER SKIP-LEVEL NOTE (paste-ready)
- Manager: devin (Eng Manager)
- Team outcome: shipped live A/B for search re-rank; +9% successful queries
- Context: scope reduced to MVP due to infra constraints; product approved reprioritization
- Calibration: Met (metric achieved) / On track (metric near target) / Shifted (scope changed)
- Risks: dependent on partner API, monitoring added
- HC ask: [HC-REQ] 1 SWE Q3 to reduce on-call load and accelerate infra work
- Quick asks for you: review tradeoffs and confirm runway for canary

ONE-LINE IC SUMMARY (paste-ready)
- Outcome: Reduced p95 latency 18% (420ms->344ms) improving CTR by 0.7pt
- Role: Implemented async batching; owned tests and rollout
- Risk/ask: Need 40 node-hours for week-8 canary [HC-REQ optional]
```

samir (Staff SWE): Love the compact examples. Suggest adding a non-quant example for research/docs: e.g., "Published 4 notes; 2 internal adopters".

olivia (PM): Add a short line for product tradeoffs: "Reason for scope change: user research showed lower priority for X". Helps skip-levels understand decision.

devin (Eng Manager): Also make calibration labels one-word for quick scanning: Met / At-Risk / Shifted.

maria (People Ops): Great — will update. Final will go to templates and I'll pin it. ETA EOD. Thanks! :sparkles: 

ops-bot: Template uploaded: https://redwood.internal/templates/skiplevel-calibration-pack-v1 (uploaded by maria) :white_check_mark:

devin (Eng Manager): Will use in tomorrow's skip-levels.
